raw_context:
Farmacorp
is the largest pharmacy retail chain in Bolivia, headquartered in
Santa Cruz de la Sierra
. The company operates over 170 branches across all nine departments of the country, holding approximately 46% of the drugstore chain market share.

Farmacorp
offers a small selection of private-label items (about 5% of its inventory) alongside a vast catalog of top international and regional manufacturer partners representing beauty, wellness, and health brands.
